name: Vice Got a Price!
guide: This is the platinum, awarded automatically once every other trophy on the list has been earned. There is nothing extra to do beyond completing the full set, so treat it as the final stamp on a finished list. If it does not pop at the end, scan the list for any trophy still unearned.

name: Just Like Paradise
guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Gone Fishing. Play the mission through as it unfolds and the trophy unlocks at its conclusion. Spoiler caution: story details are deliberately not described here.

name: Paradise Lost
guide: Unlocks when you finish Chapter 1 of the main story. Follow the chapter missions in order and the trophy pops as the chapter closes. Spoiler caution: no story specifics are given here.

name: T**s Ass Drug Money
guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the main story to earn this one. Work through the chapter missions in sequence; nothing optional or hidden is required. Spoiler caution: progress the story and it unlocks on its own.

name: Vice City, Baby!
guide: Awarded for completing Chapter 3 of the main story. Keep following the mission markers and finish the chapter's final job. Spoiler caution: the chapter's events are not described here.

name: Top Of The World, Ma
guide: Finish Chapter 4 to unlock this trophy. By this point the story is in its late stages, so it is a good moment to keep a manual save before pushing on. Spoiler caution applies throughout.

name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
guide: Complete the final mission of the main story. Before you start it, make a separate manual save so you can return to the endgame afterwards for cleanup or to revisit choices. Spoiler caution: the ending itself is not described here.

name: Trust
guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Breakfast Run. Play it through to the end and the trophy unlocks on completion. Spoiler caution: mission details are kept hidden here.

name: Break the Bank
guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission. Heists reward preparation, so go in with full health, armor and ammo and listen to the crew's callouts. Spoiler caution: the heist's twists are not described here.

name: Family Matters
guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Child's Play. Follow the mission through to its conclusion and the trophy pops automatically. Spoiler caution applies, as with all story entries.

name: DWNFALL
guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of normal story progression, so just finish the job when it becomes available. Spoiler caution: no mission details are shared here.

name: Hi-Jacked
guide: Awarded for completing the story mission VCIA Takedown. Play through the mission's objectives in order and the trophy unlocks at the end. Spoiler caution applies.

name: Snow Storm
guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Stock up before starting, as set-piece missions can be long, and the trophy pops when the mission wraps up. Spoiler caution: the operation itself is not described here.

name: A Long Road
guide: Reach 100% completion across the whole game. Use the in-game completion tracker as your checklist and hunt down whatever remains: story, activities, collectibles and exploration all feed the percentage. Expect this to be the last big push before the platinum.

name: Cunning Stunts
guide: Complete 250 Stunts. Stunt opportunities are scattered all over Leonida, so clear them region by region and keep track of which ones are done. A failed attempt costs nothing; line the stunt up and retry until it registers.

name: Master of None
description: Try each type of activity once.
guide: Try each type of activity once. Open the map and sample every distinct activity icon at least a single time; you only need to try each type, not master it. This is a good early trophy to clear while exploring.

name: The Shootist
description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges; 42 challenges are tracked on Exophase and PSNProfiles. Learn each weapon's handling and the target patterns for every lane, then replay challenges until your score reaches gold. Steady aim settings and short practice runs between attempts help a lot.

name: Top Fun
description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Learn each course's racing line with a relaxed first run, then push for the win. A loss costs nothing, so retry each location until every one has a victory.

name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
guide: Win 20 different races. Variety is the key word: the wins must come in different races, so move around the race types and locations instead of farming a single favorite event.

name: Baited My Tackle
description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Stock up on bait beforehand and learn the reeling rhythm before you take him on. If Cal wins the first meeting, challenge him again until you come out ahead.

name: Stick Fiddler
guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, play a game through to its end screen, and the trophy unlocks. Finishing matters more than winning, so pick whichever cabinet game suits you.

name: Road to Rehabilitation
description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Follow Andy's mission strand through to its last job; the earlier missions in the strand must be finished first. If the strand goes quiet, check your map and phone for the next step.

name: This Was No Boat Accident
description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Work through Kenton's strand in order until the finale becomes available, then finish it. Keep an eye on your contacts if you lose the thread of the chain.

name: The Lone Rider
description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand must be played through from its first job to the last one. Finish the finale and the trophy is yours.

name: Strangers & Freaks
description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers appear as encounters out in the world, and each strand is a short chain of jobs. Finish chains fully rather than starting many at once, and the count climbs steadily.

name: Supply & Demand
description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Play Randy's strand through every earlier job so the finale unlocks, then complete it. The trophy pops when that last mission ends.

name: Spin On This!
description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Follow Tyrone's chain of missions to its conclusion, finishing each step as it appears on the map. The final job is the one that pays out the trophy.

name: Positive Mental Attitude
description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots sit in quiet, scenic corners of the map; walk up and use the prompt at each one. Sweep region by region so none are missed on the way to full coverage.

name: Fair Game
description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. A unique animal sounds like a one-of-a-kind encounter, so keep a separate save before you take the hunt on; if the encounter goes wrong, reload rather than risk the chance being gone for this playthrough. Track Bret's request through to the hunt itself and make the shot count.

name: Don't Touch My Deck
guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden pickups grouped into themed sets, and a set only counts once every card in it is found. Focus on finishing one set at a time so your progress is easy to follow.

name: You WAiNKer!
guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK interaction wherever it is offered and keep moving to fresh spots, since repeating one location is unlikely to add to the total. Spread the effort across the whole map as you explore and it builds up naturally.

name: One Last Thing
guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are short optional objectives scattered through the world; accept and finish them as you encounter them and the total climbs on its own. If one proves stubborn, leave it and come back with better gear.

name: Hot Together
description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The description ties this to a specific partner situation, so keep a separate save before you build a run at it, in case the moment is tied to story progress. Raise the wanted level together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.

name: Retail Therapy
description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Pick three targets close together, move fast between them, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time. If the stars drop before the third shop, start the chain again.

name: Whip It Good
guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new vehicle model you encounter adds to the count, so swap cars often and visit different districts. Parking areas, docks, wealthy neighborhoods and airfields are good hunting grounds for rarer models.

name: Gunslinger
description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Line up a group of enemies before you trigger Combat Focus, then drop five of them before the effect ends. A crowded firefight or a deliberate ambush setup makes this far easier.

name: Catch Me If You Can
description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. This reads like a specific airport moment, so keep a separate save before experimenting at the airport; if the opportunity turns out to be a one-off, a reload protects you. Head to VCIA and look for a way to leave in a hurry.

name: Challenging Tank
guide: The official description is a joke line about Rhinos, so treat this cautiously as an armored-vehicle discovery feat: find a Rhino tank, get inside, and experiment with what the game might be tracking. Keep a save before you go looking, and do not assume more than the description actually says.

name: Sneakthief
description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, move quietly, watch for cameras and witnesses, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, reload and try a cleaner, slower approach.

name: Maximum Withdrawal
guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vault jobs are the heavy end of robbery: bring your best gear, plan the exit route before you go in, and get well clear after each hit. A vault only counts if you escape afterwards.

name: A Classic Blitz Play
description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Armored trucks are tough targets, so block the route, deal with the escort quickly, grab the take and vanish before the response arrives in force.

name: The Goodtime State
guide: Explore all of Leonida. Every region of the map needs a visit, so ride out to the edges: islands, swamps, back roads and far corners. Use the unexplored fog on the map as your checklist and clear it district by district.

name: Pest Control
description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Different gangs hold different operations, so identify whose turf you are hitting and keep a note of which gangs are already done. The trophy needs every gang robbed at least once, not the same one repeatedly.

name: In The Beginning…
description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This reads like a specific place-and-moment feat, so keep a separate save before seeking it out, in case the moment is tied to story progress. Find a spot on Ocean Beach that serves cocktails with a view, and take the time to enjoy one.

name: Capital Offense
description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Because this sounds like a set-piece moment, keep a separate save beforehand so a missed chance can simply be reloaded. Get into a showroom vehicle and make your exit through the glass.

name: Let's Go Bowling
description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Head to the alley and bowl; the description hints that the follow-through of your throw is what matters, so focus on a clean, complete bowling motion. Retry frames until your technique registers.

name: Personal Best
guide: The official description is deliberately cryptic, so treat this as a discovery trophy tied to your partnership rather than a feat with known steps. Keep a separate save as you experiment with partner activities, and let it unlock naturally as you play together instead of forcing a specific guess.

name: Actions Speak Louder
guide: The description points at choices made during the story. Keep manual saves before major story decisions so you can reload if a choice leads somewhere you did not intend. Spoiler caution: no choice, branch or outcome is described here.

name: Bad Luck, I Guess
guide: The official description is cryptic and suggests something must be attempted or experienced a second time. Treat this as a discovery trophy: keep a separate save, and when something goes wrong, try again instead of reloading past it. Beyond that, the honest guide is to keep playing and let it surface.

name: The Truth Is Out There
guide: The official description is deliberately cryptic, so treat this as a discovery trophy for some strange encounter out in the world. Keep exploring the odd corners of Leonida, keep a separate save before investigating anything unusual, and invent nothing: let the moment find you.

name: Ten Pin
description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, use a melee attack to knock down pedestrians like bowling pins. Find a busy sidewalk, drive slowly enough to connect, and swing as you pass the group.

name: Dime on the Dollar
description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from scores and robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts rather than spending them raw, and keep the pipeline running until the cumulative total passes the mark.

name: Treat Yo Self
guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The spending is cumulative everywhere: clothes, weapons, vehicles and services all count, so it accrues naturally as you gear up. If you are short near the end, one deliberate shopping spree closes the gap.

name: Little Boxes
guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the property market as funds allow; garages double as vehicle storage, so they pay off well beyond this trophy. Check the property listings regularly in case new garages become available.

name: On the Spot
description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it through the app so it is saved to your collection. Ten registrations complete the set, so register as you go rather than hunting at the end.
